# SectionHeading

A heading for a section inside a page: the thin–bold title at title-m or title-s, with an optional count, a right-side action or link, and a one-line caveat.

`SongNodes.SectionHeading` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.SectionHeading title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.SectionHeading" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (SectionHeadingProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lead` | `string` | Thin lead-in before the colon ("Crate"). |
| `title` * | `string` | Bold title. |
| `size` | `"title-m" \| "title-s"` | Heading level and size. |
| `level` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | Heading element level. |
| `count` | `string` | Count after the title ("47 tracks"). |
| `end` | `ReactNode` | Right-side action or link. |
| `caveat` | `ReactNode` | One-line caveat under the title. |
| `rule` | `boolean` | Rule under the heading. |
